import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 50;
    static final int MAX_M = 50;
    static final int MAX_K = 50;
    static final int MAX_T = MAX_N + MAX_K + 1;
    static final int MAX_NODES = MAX_N * MAX_T + 1;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = MAX_K + (MAX_M * 2 * MAX_K + MAX_N) * (MAX_T - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int edge_cnt;
    static int[] uu = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] vv = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] uv = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] cost = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] ccost = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] cc = new int[MAX_EDGES * 2];

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj_list = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = edge_cnt++;
        uu[h] = u; vv[h] = v; uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h * 2] = cap;
        cc[h * 2 + 1] = 0;
        adj_list[u].add(h * 2);
        adj_list[v].add(h * 2 + 1);
    }

    static int[] pi = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] kk = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] bb = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] pq = new int[1 + MAX_NODES];
    static int[] iq = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int pq_cnt;

    static boolean LT(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
    }

    static int i2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > pq_cnt) return 0;
        if (i < pq_cnt && LT(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }

    static void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i / 2) != 0 && LT(u, pq[j]); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i2(i)) != 0 && LT(pq[j], u); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void pq_add(int u) {
        iq[u] = ++pq_cnt;
        pq_up(u);
    }

    static int pq_pop() {
        int u = pq[1];
        int v = pq[pq_cnt--];
        iq[v] = 1;
        pq_dn(v);
        return u;
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(pi, INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        kk[s] = 0;
        pq_add(s);
        while (pq_cnt != 0) {
            int u = pq_pop();
            for (int he : adj_list[u]) {
                if (cc[he] == 0) continue;
                int h = he / 2;
                int p = pi[u] + ((he & 1) == 0 ? ccost[h] : -ccost[h]);
                int v = u ^ uv[h];
                if (pi[v] == INF) {
                    pi[v] = p;
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1;
                    bb[v] = he;
                    pq_add(v);
                } else if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && kk[v] > kk[u] + 1)) {
                    pi[v] = p;
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1;
                    bb[v] = he;
                    pq_up(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push(int s, int t) {
        int u, h, he;
        for (u = t; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            he = bb[u];
            h = he / 2;
            cc[he]--;
            cc[he ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        System.arraycopy(cost, 0, ccost, 0, edge_cnt);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (pi[t] == INF) break;
            push(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < edge_cnt; h++) {
                int u = uu[h], v = vv[h];
                if (pi[u] != INF && pi[v] != INF)
                    ccost[h] += pi[u] - pi[v];
            }
        }
        int total_cost = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < edge_cnt; h++)
            total_cost += cost[h] * cc[h * 2 + 1];
        return total_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int[] start = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            start[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        ArrayList<Integer>[] base_adj = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) base_adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int b = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            base_adj[a].add(b);
            base_adj[b].add(a);
        }
        int t = n + k + 1;
        int N_total = n * t + 1;
        edge_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N_total; i++) adj_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : base_adj[i]) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        add_edge(u, v, 1, c + (2 * x - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                add_edge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        int source = N_total - 1;
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            add_edge(source, start[h] * t, 1, 0);
        System.out.println(edmonds_karp(source, 0 * t + t - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
